### Eunice — [Box Plot, e.g. "Flipper Length by Species"]

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
# penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()
penguins |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Flipper Length in mm",
    title = "Penguin Species vs Flipper Length",
    fill = "Species"
  )
```
